## Hardening Objective

A concise summary of the proposed hardening measure or defensive improvement.

## Threat Description & Risk Analysis

Describe the theoretical threat model, residual risk, abuse scenario, or weakness this hardening measure mitigates.

## Affected Components

- [ ] Contracts (`contracts/rwa-asset`, `compliance`, `registry`, `governance`, `oracle-adapter`)
- [ ] TypeScript SDK (`sdk/`)
- [ ] CI / Workflows (`.github/workflows/`)
- [ ] Documentation / Specifications (`docs/`)

## Proposed Remediation / Implementation

Detail the technical approach to implementing this hardening change.

## Verification & Acceptance Criteria

How should this improvement be tested or verified (e.g., negative test cases, invariant checks, static analysis)?
